evidence.quoted_text: if commit not in repo.git('rev-list', tip).decode().splitlines():
evidence.reason: Line 53 verifies only that the reported commit is reachable from `tip`, not that it lies in `target..tip`. A commit older than `row['target']` can therefore pass; for `fixed`, the later path-touch check does not establish that the commit fixed a finding raised at `target`, and `superseded` has no path-touch guard at all. The proposed `target..tip` bound addresses this.
